data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'laur', meaning 'laurel'. In Christian tradition, laurel symbolizes victory and resurrection. The name Loralie carries the meaning “Laurel flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Loralie usually hope their child will grow to embody laurel flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
